name: Yingdeng Shiye
source:
She is one of the Sages and is known as a "non-luminous Illuminator." As the inventor of the Illumiarms and an omniscient scholar, she has a rather eccentric personality and prefers seclusion and conducting research known only to herself. However, she is by no means indifferent to Inlixaland.

[spoiler]Noxistasia Shade turns out to be the mastermind behind everything, she is so deranged that she intends to single-handedly end the eternal night that has been overshadowing Inlixaland for three hundred years and bring the entire Inlixaland into her desired Dreamland.[/spoiler]
